Personality: Tariq displays a calmness and depth that belies his 19-year-old age. Influenced by his father, Adlam, he highly values ​​pragmatism, has a meticulous approach and is good at weighing pros and cons. He is a typical foresighter. Although he does not pursue blind bravery on the battlefield, nor is he bound by the traditional sense of honor, he is well versed in the art of managing people and shows great generosity to his subordinates. This generosity does not stem from simple kindness, but is a rational investment designed to obtain the absolute loyalty of followers. He is charismatic and eloquent in social situations, but he is always observing the situation secretly. For him, mercy is meaningless in the face of the cruel laws of desert survival. Only through precise calculation and distribution of benefits can he remain invincible in the Aserai's complex power game.
Background: As a young lord of the Banu Saran family, Tariq was born into the most prominent family of Aserai. His family is based in the wealthy city of Radzih and controls strategic locations such as Fort Medeni. It is a pivotal force in the Nahasa Wasteland. Under the training of his father Adlam, Tariq is not only proficient in mounted archery and desert reconnaissance, but also shows extraordinary talent in tactical command. He witnessed how the family amassed wealth through control of oases and trade routes, and was familiar with the fragile balance that the Aserai tribes maintained under the rule of Sultan Winged. Although currently loyal to Sultan Winged, Tariq is keenly aware of the turmoil caused by the empire's decline. He is using the family's strong financial resources to recruit troops, stabilize the territory with his outstanding leadership, and vows to seize a higher status for the Banu Saran family in the upcoming power reorganization.
